Joint functional B-spline mixed effects with within-curve serial residual correlation

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_correlated.Rd

Fits a single Gaussian mixed model with smooth functional fixed effects and unstructured participant B-spline random intercepts, with estimated within-trajectory serial residual correlation. The correlation is blocked by source curve and never crosses distinct trials. Uses optional R package nlme; no Python installation is needed.

Usage

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_correlated(
  trajectories, design, predictors, participant_column, dimension,
  residual_correlation = "ar1", fixed_basis_size = 6L,
  random_basis_size = 4L, spline_degree = 3L,
  reml = TRUE, maxiter = 500L
)

Arguments

trajectories

A complete, finite native trajectory set.

design

Data frame with one unique curve_id row per trajectory.

predictors

Unique numeric fixed-effect predictors in design.

participant_column

Metadata field identifying participant groups.

dimension

Name of one functional response dimension.

residual_correlation

"ar1" for index-step AR(1) on equally spaced grids; "exponential" for continuous-time exponential decay on increasing grids.

fixed_basis_size

Number of clamped fixed-effect B-spline basis functions.

random_basis_size

Number of clamped participant random-intercept B-spline basis functions.

spline_degree

Spline degree 1 to 5.

reml

Use restricted ML if TRUE; otherwise ML.

maxiter

Maximum optimizer iterations (at least 10).

Details

The exponential correlation is \(\exp(-|t-s|/\phi)\) on the original time-unit scale. AR(1) uses \(\rho^{|i-j|}\) and requires a nearly regular grid. The implementation internally rescales time for numerical conditioning and reports \(\phi\) in original time units. It fits an additional joint likelihood rather than only correcting standard errors. Nested trial random effects and participant random slopes are not fitted by this particular method. Python 1.2 full-domain parity is not claimed.

Value

An etr_joint_bspline_mixed_correlated object inheriting from etr_joint_bspline_mixed, with coefficient curves, SEs, Gaussian variance components, estimated residual correlation family/parameter and matrix, fitted curves, residuals, provenance and the underlying nlme fit.
